card.name: Morphing Jar
card.officialText: FLIP: Both players discard as many cards as possible from their hands, then each player draws 5 cards.

design.trigger: A real Flip Summon only; normal summon and effect-flip are rejected.
design.resolution: Discard both active representatives' hands to their team Graveyards first, then each active team draws up to five from its own current Deck.
design.deckOut: A team with fewer than five cards draws what remains and loses; if both fail in the same simultaneous resolution, the result is a draw.
design.ownership: Controller team determines effect context; physical UIDs stay attached to cards. Inactive partner reserve hands/Decks are untouched.
design.replay: activationId receipt is serialized in JSON and consumed on successful or negated resolution.

testCases: real Flip Summon only; normal summon/effect-flip rejected
both active hands discarded before drawing
exactly five cards drawn by each team in order
empty hand and inactive partner reserves
fewer than five cards causes failed draw after drawing as many as possible
one-team deck-out and simultaneous two-team deck-out
stolen source resolves for controller team
negation and replay protection across JSON restoration
3+3 zones, separate Field Zone and Extra Deck 5
physical UID conservation and input immutability

certification.reason: Isolated behavior adapter only; no resolver, cardMetadata, cardCertifications, manifest or allowlist changes. M61 handoff remains pending.

limitations: Adapter not integrated into the central monster-effect resolver; Morphing Jar remains uncertified and not released to inventory.
TagDuel fixtures run offline; no Discord gateway/guild session.
Deck-out handling is tested in a deterministic adapter fixture; full engine chain ordering awaits M61 integration.
